en.html:
After sunset, Chachamaru took me out of the castle. Driving herself, she passed through the city toward the bay.

We stopped in the parking lot of an expensive hotel reasonably well known around Kamakura. We were both in civilian clothes, although at this establishment uniforms might have looked less conspicuous.

Naturally, avoiding clothes that announced rank and identity at a glance—particularly hers—must have had a purpose.

We entered by a deserted rear entrance and stepped into the <ruby>lift<rt>elevator</rt></ruby>.

It carried us to the top floor.

We entered by a deserted rear entrance and stepped into the liftelevator.

It carried us to the top floor.

　やがて停車した場所は、鎌倉近郊でそれなりに名を
知られている高級ホテルの駐車場だった。
　今は俺も茶々丸も私服だが、場所柄、かえって軍服

　昇降機は――最上階へ。

Chachamaru"AAAA! Too much frankness!"
Wolf"What are you doing, my dear? Arriving and immediately attracting a sentence against yourself."
Chachamaru"Bhosdike, you greeted a visitor by declaring war on his HAT! Whose fault do you think it is!?"
Wolf"Yours, presumably. A foolish person has done something foolish."
Kageaki"Correct."
Wolf"Ah, as expected. A dear friend of mine, but she does have this habit of blaming others without justification."
Wolf"Even my perfectly reasonable campaign for proper hat protocol is not safe from her objections."
Kageaki"We shall set the hats aside for the moment."
Wolf"I consider advice a friend’s duty. Warmly observe, repeatedly advise: that is my intention."
Kageaki"A proper response, I think."
Kageaki"How fortunate you are in your friends, Chachamaru."
Wolf"Indeed, Chachamaru!"
Chachamaru"Why is apun the accused while the hat lunatic gives character evidence?"
Wolf"Why are you crying? He has offered only friendship."
Chachamaru"Because from the heart apun wanted to cry! Lately the world has stopped being nice!"
Wolf"An excellent observation. Self-pity assists nobody."
Kageaki"Agreed. Now, Hat Protocol."
Wolf"Yes?"
Kageaki"What gathering is to be held here?"

Kageaki"A lecture on the health benefits of hat removal?"
Wolf"Hmm. Not precisely, but not entirely far away."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Lie! Neither precise nor nearby! Please stop looking at apun as though punishment has become your life’s purpose!"
Wolf"Suppose people argued whether the right shoe or the left should go on first. Would you find them ridiculous?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Wolf"And Christians fiercely disputing the proper order in which to make the sign of the cross? Ridiculous also?"
Kageaki"..."
Wolf"Ridiculous, my friend."
Wolf"A value that does not exist... treated as existing, revered, even fought over as though its validity could demand another man’s surrender."
Wolf"Ridiculous."
Wolf"And yet—is this not intellectual activity itself?"
Wolf"What besides intelligence could accomplish such a feat?"
Wolf"Anybody can obey reality. An unintelligent beast manages that much. But give fiction equal value with reality, then prostrate oneself before it—can a beast do this?"

en.html:
Kageaki"A theory of religion?"
Wolf"Precisely."
Wolf"Some say religion makes fools of humanity. Entire misunderstanding. Religion is the product of intellectual activity of a very high order."
Wolf"One might call it the most human invention in human history."
Kageaki"I see. Religion as an intellectual game."
Kageaki"Ridiculous."
Wolf"Entirely."
Kageaki"But viewed that way, not altogether bad."
Wolf"Is it?"
Kageaki"Hmph..."
Wolf"Ha ha ha!"
Chachamaru"...How are you two actually understanding each other?"
Kageaki"Then the gathering here is a religious debate?"
Wolf"Not a debate. The conclusion is already settled."
Wolf"We are consulting about action based upon that conclusion."
Kageaki"Which is?"
Wolf"Blasphemy."
Wolf"God, hitherto a sacred fiction, an inviolable hope—we drag it down onto this earth. Make it exist like a monster・・・・・・・."
Wolf"Comrade Kageaki Minato. My greeting is late, but meeting you today shall remain a joy throughout my life."
Kageaki"...I have not yet heard your name."
Wolf"Wolf."
Kageaki"Wolf...?"
